name: Wollbachalm - Malga Rio di Valle
kurzbeschreibung:
**Wollbachalm – Malga Rio di Valle in Ahrntal – Valle Aurina**

Discover the **Wollbachalm**, a charming alpine hut nestled in the heart of **Ahrntal – Valle Aurina** in **Tirol**. Perched at an elevation of 1,800 meters, this idyllic retreat offers breathtaking views of the **Dolomites** and the **Alpe di Siusi**.

Indulge in traditional **Tiroler** hospitality with hearty dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Speckknödel**, and fresh mountain cheeses. The cozy atmosphere, paired with crisp mountain air, makes it the perfect spot for relaxation and outdoor adventures.

Hike to the **Malga Rio di Valle**, a picturesque alpine meadow just a short walk away, where you can enjoy panoramic vistas and perhaps spot local wildlife. Whether you're seeking adventure or tranquility, **Wollbachalm** promises an unforgettable experience in one of **Tirol’s** most stunning valleys.
